statement: SRC validation requires no unresolved SOURCE_GAP.
violation: SRC validation accepts a file without no unresolved SOURCE_GAP.
verification: Run the declared validation check before accepting generated SRC files.

statement: SRC validation requires no unresolved ROUTING_GAP.
violation: SRC validation accepts a file without no unresolved ROUTING_GAP.
verification: Run the declared validation check before accepting generated SRC files.

statement: SRC validation requires no unresolved SOURCE_CONFLICT.
violation: SRC validation accepts a file without no unresolved SOURCE_CONFLICT.
verification: Run the declared validation check before accepting generated SRC files.

statement: SRC validation requires no unresolved STALE_ARTIFACT.
violation: SRC validation accepts a file without no unresolved STALE_ARTIFACT.
verification: Run the declared validation check before accepting generated SRC files.

statement: SOURCE_GAP applies when required source authority is missing.
violation: Generation proceeds after missing source authority is detected.
verification: Check missing source authority before generating dependent records.

statement: ROUTING_GAP applies when ownership or target routing is unclear.
violation: Generation assigns an unclear concept to an SRC file without a single owner.
verification: Verify every concept has exactly one owner before generation.

statement: SOURCE_CONFLICT applies when two same-level or active source claims conflict.
violation: Generation silently merges or ranks conflicting same-level claims.
verification: Run same-level conflict checks before dependent generation.

statement: STALE_ARTIFACT applies when active status or revalidation status is unclear.
violation: Generation uses an artifact with unclear active status or stale validation state.
verification: Check active status and revalidation status before using an artifact.

statement: GOVERNANCE_DRIFT applies when downstream files weaken or reinterpret GOV or SRC authority.
violation: A downstream file relaxes, reframes, or bypasses upstream authority.
verification: Compare downstream statements against controlling GOV and SRC records.

statement: Unresolved governance or cross-family conflicts escalate to GOV-00.
violation: A governance or cross-family conflict is resolved inside SRC-INDEX or another lower authority file.
verification: Review conflict scope and authority family before resolution.

statement: Dependent generation must stop until SOURCE_GAP, ROUTING_GAP, SOURCE_CONFLICT, STALE_ARTIFACT, or GOVERNANCE_DRIFT is resolved.
violation: Dependent generation continues with an unresolved gap, conflict, stale artifact, or drift classification.
verification: Check unresolved classification registry before generating dependent artifacts.
